generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder should have satisfactorily completed as a prime contractor for similar work in Rubber lining of various types of vessels or supply erection of MSRL tanks in any thermal power plant or process industries. As a proof, the bidder shall upload multiple Work Orders/POs, limited to a maximum of 3, from any thermal power plant or process industry. and

The bidder shall have executed similar works of aggregate value not less than Rs. 8.50 Lakhs, through multiple Work Orders/POs limited to a maximum of 3, (i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26) (2021-22 to 2025-26). As proof, the bidder shall furnish the relevant Work Done Certificates/POs issued by an Officer not below the rank of Chief Engineer or Head of the Project. (Work done/POs with relevant invoice of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year in which the tenders are invited).

The bidder shall have minimum average annual financial turnover of Rs. 17.00 Lakhs, for two years in the preceding five financial years (i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26). As a proof, the bidder shall furnish profit & loss account statement copy or turnover certificate duly certified by registered chartered accountant. (Financial turnover of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year in which the tenders are invited).
